name: Afterpay
label: Afterpay — Afterpay / Clearpay Online API v2
description: Official Afterpay / Clearpay Online API v2 (Block). Docs: https://developers.afterpay.com/afterpay-online-developer/api-reference/reference/introduction. Production host https://global-api.afterpay.com (regions AU, NZ, US, CA, UK, FR, IT, ES). One node; operations via `operation`. operation=trigger is kind:ingress — it does not open a socket. Use a BPMN message start / catch / boundary event; StudioQuack webhook ingress correlates onto those events. There is no Webhook node. HARD PCI: cardholder data never enters the graph. Use processor tokens (pm_, nonce, encryptedCard, vault id) only. Never PAN, CVC, track data, or raw bank account numbers on INPUT/OUTPUT/logs. API keys are StudioQuack password secrets. BNPL. Clearpay in UK. Age/credit rules. Token from Afterpay JS — never PAN. Errors raise a BPMN error for the error boundary event (INVALID_INPUT, AUTH_FAILED, RATE_LIMITED, HTTP_<status>, REQUEST_FAILED); secrets are redacted.
author: 5c8b0d45-1d10-4f2e-844c-2318af96b2fa

ports.name: input
ports.description: Per-operation fields for Afterpay. Secrets never on this port. HARD PCI: cardholder data never enters the graph. Use processor tokens (pm_, nonce, encryptedCard, vault id) only. Never PAN, CVC, track data, or raw bank account numbers on INPUT/OUTPUT/logs. API keys are StudioQuack password secrets.

schema.label: Operation
schema.description: Overrides config operation. EXACT: order_create | order_auth | order_capture | order_void | refund | trigger. trigger is ingress (BPMN message event), not HTTP.

schema.label: Id
schema.description: Resource id when the path uses {id}.

schema.label: amount
schema.description: Afterpay Money envelope escape hatch {amount, currency}. Purpose fields amount_value/currency merge as amount.amount / amount.currency via bodyMap. Example: {"amount":"100.00","currency":"USD"}.

schema.label: amount_value
schema.description: Money amount string on order_create / refund. Nested as amount.amount (Afterpay's inner key; not Adyen's value). Example: 100.00.

schema.label: currency
schema.description: ISO-4217 currency on order_create / refund. Nested as amount.currency. Example: USD.

schema.label: consumer
schema.description: Consumer {phoneNumber, givenNames, surname, email} for order_create.

schema.label: Environment
schema.description: API host. sandbox → global-api-sandbox.afterpay.com; production → global-api.afterpay.com. Select via config.

ports.name: output
ports.description: OfficialApiNode result: {status,http_status,data}. Errors raise a BPMN error for the error boundary event (INVALID_INPUT, AUTH_FAILED, RATE_LIMITED, HTTP_<status>, REQUEST_FAILED); secrets are redacted.

schema.label: Data
schema.description: Parsed JSON body. Never secrets or PAN.

configurationParameters.label: Operation
configurationParameters.description: HTTP verb to run. EXACT: order_create | order_auth | order_capture | order_void | refund | trigger. Default order_create. operation=trigger is kind:ingress — it does not open a socket. Use a BPMN message start / catch / boundary event; StudioQuack webhook ingress correlates onto those events. There is no Webhook node.

configurationParameters.label: Secret Key
configurationParameters.description: Afterpay credential (basic Authorization). StudioQuack secret. Never INPUT, never logged.

configurationParameters.label: Environment
configurationParameters.description: Sandbox uses global-api-sandbox.afterpay.com; production uses global-api.afterpay.com.

configurationParameters.label: Webhook Key
configurationParameters.description: Engine Webhook API Key binding ($webhookKeyRef) routing inbound HTTP webhooks to this node.
